gizmo.title: Jaantus radar
gizmo.description: Jaantus radar (caarocaaro) oo loogu talagalay moodeellada bislaanshaha iyo dhibcaynta wejiyada, sida HEOSAT. Wuxuu ka kooban yahay beddel qoraal ah iyo shax xog.

configure.title: Cinwaan
configure.description: Cinwaanka jaantuska; sidoo kale waxaa loo isticmaalaa magaciisa la heli karo.

configure.title: Qaybaha
configure.description: Hal qayb sadarkiiba. Wuxuu u baahan yahay ugu yaraan 3.

configure.title: Dhibcaha
configure.description: Tirooyin hakad lagu kala saaray, mid qayb kasta oo isla habka ah.

configure.title: Dhibcaha bartilmaameedka
configure.description: Tirooyin hakad lagu kala saaray, mid qayb kasta oo isla habka ah.

configure.title: Muuji sharraxaadda
configure.description: Muuji sharraxaad magacaabaysa dhibcaha iyo bartilmaameedyada.

configure.title: Koobban
configure.description: Jaantus ka yar oo aan lahayn calaamado, sharraxaad ama shax xog. Dul saar barta si aad u aragto qiimayaasheeda.

advanced.title: Calaamadda dhibcaha
advanced.description: Calaamadda sharraxaadda iyo shaxda ee dhibcaha.

advanced.title: Calaamadda bartilmaameedka
advanced.description: Calaamadda sharraxaadda iyo shaxda ee bartilmaameedyada.
